name: spec/archive
description: Request: archive this merge request's completed OpenSpec changes (the archive job removes the label)

name: spec/unarchived
description: A related OpenSpec change is not archived yet (set by the labels job)

name: spec/archived
description: Every related OpenSpec change is archived (set by the labels job)

name: spec/not-started
description: No task of the related OpenSpec changes is done (set by the labels job)

name: spec/in-progress
description: Some tasks of the related OpenSpec changes are done (set by the labels job)

name: spec/done
description: Every task of the related OpenSpec changes is done (set by the labels job)
